metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 inspect and render program in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp), with the build configuration in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt).

Build from `output/` with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. The executable is `build/las14` and accepts `--input` and `--output`.

The build passed. I also verified round trips for point formats 0–10 and a format 9 file with waveform and Extra Bytes metadata. A malformed standard WKT record returned `invalid_document`.

editorial.last_message: Build and formats-0-through-10/waveform checks succeeded. Three cases fail: zero legacy return counters evade consistency checks, and float Extra Bytes metadata consumes four-byte values instead of eight-byte unions.
